sentences.text: The scheme SDT-90DSDTPCGS is part of the Government of India's efforts to support the development of small and medium enterprises.
The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to small and medium enterprises for their growth and sustainability.
Benefits include access to credit facilities and financial support for various business activities.
Eligibility criteria typically include being a registered small or medium enterprise as defined by the Ministry of MSME.
The application process generally involves submitting a proposal to the designated financial institution or agency.
The timeline for processing applications may vary based on the financial institution's internal procedures.
Implementing authorities include the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and associated financial institutions.
